name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a garage conversion typically cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage conversion in the Los Angeles area can vary significantly, generally ranging from $80,000 to $200,000 or more, depending on several factors. These include the size of the garage, the intended use (e.g., basic living space versus a full ADU with a kitchen and bathroom), the quality of finishes chosen, and the extent of structural or utility upgrades required. Permitting fees and architectural design costs also contribute to the overall budget. A detailed consultation helps provide a more accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversion costs in Los Angeles typically range from $80,000 to over $200,000, depending on size, intended use, finishes, and necessary upgrades.
